Well imagine how my Gangrel newsletter is looking at the moment! We
haven't seen anything really Gangrelly since Final Nights...

;(

> BTW, can you give any pointers which other clans we can expect in The
> Anarchs? I hope it惻l be more than Gangrel and Caitiffs. <g>

Well, since they haven't developed it yet, I would say it's a little
early to be asking!

Expect about 15 - 16 Gangrel (all new, type 3). Expect 1 vamp from
each Camerilla clan. Expect about 10 Caitiffs. Maybe another vampire
for each Sabbat clan too (although I think this might be unlikely
since the Sabbat will outnumber the Camerilla in sets 2 - 3 by
then...).

Expect a lot of smallish vampires (except the Gangrels, which will be
a bigger spread). Expect Xavier (Ex Justicar) and a load of other
cannon characters.

New Protean toys? Well, we might see a few, but I expect the key
element of the set will be wacky cards that will screw over the key
sects (prince hosers, archbishop / cardinal hosers), and probably more
weapons and violence-orientated stuff.

To be honest, though, it is too early to say. Since we don't know what
the new cards in the Cammie set do for sure, I'd look at the hear and
now, eh?

;)

DH
